2921-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2921-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 3.

1879-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-6752-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

401-640-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-640-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Repeat.

1479-2841-6754-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-6754-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2558-7396-8095--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-7396-8095--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers. Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

240-647-728-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-647-728-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

240-4460-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-4460-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

884-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3532-5060-5078-7719.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4907-5231-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4907-5231-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3459-4311-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4871-6791-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

934-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1545-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Trostani triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1545-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

1445-4871-5632-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5632-6797.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3774-4499-4554-5902.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1491-2466-6702.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Kilo, adding {C}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-2511-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-2511-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1429-1477-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-1477-5402.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1061-2362.easyPrerequisites: Endless Evil attached to Timestream Navigator.
1061-2362.description:
During your upkeep, Endless Evil triggers, creating a 1/1 token copy of Timestream Navigator.
During your next upkeep, Endless Evil triggers, creating a 1/1 token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the ability of a Timestream Navigator token that did not enter the battlefield this turn by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn.
Repeat from 2.

575-4489-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C}{G}.
575-4489-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the creature face-up, allowing you to play the creature from exile this turn.
Cast the creature from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast using two or less mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

1272-2051-2546-4566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1272-2051-2546-4566.description:
Activate Barren Moor's cycling ability by paying {B} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Barren Moor ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Barren Moor and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2530-2842-2946.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2034-2530-2842-2946.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cult Conscript enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

628-3108-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.
628-3108-5256.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

134-3098-3449-3809-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {1}{U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {1}{U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1479-2692-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
